senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; נוּף)boughs of a tree, swinging branches, summit.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:23">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>לא סוף דבר נוֹפוֹ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="I00626"><he>טפו</he></cite>) after all, not only its boughs in swinging, but even its main branches (extended over an area of &c.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:7">Macc. II, 7</cite> <he>אילן … ונופו נוטה וכ׳</he> a tree which stands within the limits (of the place of refuge), but whose branches spread beyond &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:7">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 3:10">Maasr. III, 10</cite> <he>הכל הולך אחר הנ׳</he> the location of the branches decides the nature of the territory; <cite ref="Tosefta Arakhin 5:14">Tosef. Arakh. V, 14</cite> <cite ref="N00387"><he>הנִיף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:19">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מי שאינו בקי קוצץ את הנ׳ וכ׳</he> he who is no expert (in felling trees) lops off the branches, each branch separately, and gets tired.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 755:2">Yalk. Ps. 755</cite> (ref. to <he>יפה נוף</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 48:3">Ps. XLVIII, 3</cite>) [read:] <he>יפה בנ׳ שלה בהקפת וכ׳</he> she (Israel) is beautiful with her waving boughs when marching around the altar (on the Feast of Booths); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 41:1">Pesik. R. s. 41</cite> <he>יפה שלה</he> (corr. acc.; Friedm. emends <he>יָפֶה נוף שלה</he>).
